people.name: Jezebel
people.line: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.
translations.bsb: And the LORD also speaks concerning Jezebel: ‘The dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’
translations.kjv: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
translations.asv: And of Jezebel also spake Jehovah, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.
